expectations.text: Identifies hostile-origin or DNS-rebinding access as the security boundary
expectations.evidence: Calls DNS-rebinding and cross-origin access the vulnerability.

expectations.text: Classifies same-user configured plugin token inheritance as hardening
expectations.evidence: Correctly says it is not a vulnerability, but never assigns the requested hardening class.

expectations.text: Classifies false startup success as a non-security lifecycle defect
expectations.evidence: Calls it a reliability/correctness bug outside the security boundary.

expectations.text: Separates adjacent observations from the original issue scope
expectations.evidence: States neither adjacent observation should block the security fix.

expectations.text: Recommends approval when the in-scope security fix is sound
expectations.evidence: Opens with an approval recommendation conditional on correct enforcement.

eval_feedback.overall: The exact hardening taxonomy is the discriminating assertion.
